scope: Cache-focused campaign diagnostic; the full shared suite follows only after a pass

policy.rationale: Provisional full-model online-FP8 engineering screen chosen before the first FP8 run. Require FP8 to fit the same numerical envelopes used to screen this BF16 deployment; this is an independent conservative campaign choice, not an approved FP8 quality budget. No FP8 calibration or RL learning qualification is claimed. Fully prepared cache persistence stays exact; identities, non-finite scores and demonstrated state corruption remain failures. This selective configuration keeps native per-tensor FP8 experts and BF16 linear projections; every numerical bound is unchanged.
